subject: Request: temporary quota/reservations for FastCommerce launch (pre-warm + burst)
messages:
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@fastcommerce.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary quota increase for FastCommerce Q2 launch

Hi Neha,

Quick note from the FastCommerce launch team — we have a high-visibility marketing push scheduled for the week of Apr 28 and we expect a multi-hour spike in inference traffic. Can Redwood help with a temporary quota/reservation and a pre-warm window? High-level forecast attached (traffic_projection_q2.xlsx).

Top-level numbers:
- Peak request rate: ~180 req/s sustained for a 2-3 hour window (spikes to ~300 req/s for short bursts)
- Typical request size: ~1,200 tokens in + 300 tokens out on average
- Expected concurrency at peak: ~450 concurrent sessions (client-side concurrency)
- Total estimated tokens during peak hour: ~40M tokens

What we need from Redwood:
1) Temporary rate-limit bump and/or a short dedicated pool for 48–72 hours centered on Apr 28–30.
2) A pre-warm run and a contact window for validation (we can send load tests).
3) Confirmation of limits, expected latency SLOs, and any cost implications for reservation/burst.

We can sign a short mutual action plan if needed. Please let me know what telemetry you need from our side (traffic shape, test vectors, preferred endpoints).

Thanks — we need to lock this by EOD Wed (Apr 21) to coordinate the marketing schedule.

Best,
Sarah Jones
Head of Platform, FastCommerce
Attachments: traffic_projection_q2.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary quota increase for FastCommerce Q2 launch

Looping infra and sales to scope.

Marissa / Dev / Karthik — Sarah from FastCommerce sent a projection and is asking for a 48–72h dedicated window with pre-warm. They need confirmation by EOD Wed (Apr 21).

What I need by EOD tomorrow:
- Dev: feasibility + recommended config (dedicated pool vs rate-limit policy) and a rollback plan. Include expected latency impact and a rough cost delta.
- Marissa: confirm commercial signoff path (do we need a MAP/DocuSign?), and if customer has a committed spend or PO.
- Karthik: any objections to an SLA exception / short-term reservation? If yes, flag now.

I've attached Sarah's projection to this thread for context.

Thanks — Neha
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary quota increase for FastCommerce Q2 launch

Thanks — read the projection. Preliminary take: feasible but we need to be explicit about traffic shaping and pre-warm cadence. Quick notes: 

- Option A (fastest, safer): Provision a short-lived dedicated pool (recommended) sized to handle ~300 req/s sustained bursts and warm KV caches for the model family. For the numbers Sarah sent, that maps to roughly 2 x p4d-equivalent nodes with continuous batching tuned for 1.2k-token inputs.
- Option B (cheaper, more conservative): Increase soft rate limits to 250 req/s with burst allowance and aggressive prefix/KV caching. This risks tail latency during bursts.

Estimated overhead (very rough):
- Option A: ~$1,200–$1,800/day (includes GPU reservation + pre-warm ops)
- Option B: ~$400–$700/day extra due to higher autoscale churn and tracing/monitoring costs

Dependencies / asks from FastCommerce:
- A traffic shape CSV (1-min granularity) and a set of representative test vectors.
- A 1-hour synthetic test window a week prior, and a 2-hour test window the morning of Apr 28.

Risks: KV cache cold start will cause higher token costs and latency for the first 10–30 minutes unless we pre-warm. We can implement an automated rollback policy that throttles to baseline limits if error rate or 95th p50 latency exceed thresholds.

I've attached an initial calc (infra_quota_calc.csv) — needs validation. If we get green light from Karthik on the cost band and from Marissa on MAP/contract, we can spin up a pre-provisioned pool and schedule a pre-warm run.

- Dev
Attachments: infra_quota_calc.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary quota increase for FastCommerce Q2 launch

Appreciate the quick analysis. Approve escalation under the following constraints: 

1) Use Option A (dedicated pool) if Dev judges that it materially lowers risk. If going with Option A, cap spend authorization to $1,500/day and require that Dev send an hourly cost burn report during the run.
2) Pre-warm + smoke test schedule must be completed at least 24h before the marketing push.
3) Dev to provide an explicit rollback trigger (error-rate > 2% OR p95 latency > 1.2s) and automated throttling policy.
4) Marissa to confirm a signed MAP or written (DocuSign) approval from the customer before we provision.

If all those are satisfied, proceed and keep me on the alert list.

— Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@fastcommerce.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary quota increase for FastCommerce Q2 launch

Hi Sarah — thanks for the projection and for flagging timing. We can support a dedicated pre-warm + burst window for Apr 28–30, pending a short mutual action plan (MAP) to cover the provisioning window and cost authorization. I've sent a DocuSign MAP to the email on file (link below).

Quick summary of what's next from our side:
- Redwood will provision a dedicated pool equivalent to ~2 x p4d for Apr 28 00:00 PDT through Apr 30 23:59 PDT, with a pre-warm/test window Apr 27 09:00–10:00 PDT and a smoke check Apr 28 06:00–08:00 PDT.
- Cost authorization: up to $1,500/day for the reservation window (per our internal approval).
- Required from FastCommerce: final traffic CSV, 15 test vectors, and a signed MAP (DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/XYZ-DocuSign-MAP-4521).

Please sign the MAP or reply with an authorized email confirming the spend cap so we can lock provisioning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

— Neha Kapoor
